biggest_catch: You must have exclusively purchased your heating fuel from Grays Heating Oil for at least the past year (or contracted to for the upcoming season) to refer — a new or occasional customer cannot earn the referral credit. The new customer must sign up for a minimum one-year automatic delivery account.
catches: The referrer must have exclusively purchased heating fuel from Grays Heating Oil for at least the past year/heating season (or contracted to do so for the upcoming season).
The new customer must sign up for a home heating automatic delivery account with a minimum one-year requirement.
New customers must not have been an existing Grays Heating Oil customer in the past 5 years.
Only the referrer earns the $100 account credit; the referred customer gets no stated referral reward (they may separately qualify for the new-customer gallon promotion).
The credit is usable only toward future fuel or service purchases — it offsets planned spending, not cash.
Page says 'conditions may apply — contact us for complete program details'; Warren/Rockland, Maine area.
